question: The rate of advertisement on a TV channel is directly proportional to the duration of the advertisement. If the rate of an advertisement of 20 seconds is ₹1,25,000, then the rate of an advertisement of 25 seconds will be ₹_________.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the unitary method, we can find the rate per second directly.

Rate for 20 seconds = ₹1,25,000

Rate for 1 second = 1,25,000 ÷ 20 = ₹6,250

Rate for 25 seconds = 6,250 × 25 = ₹1,56,250

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,56,250.**
